title: Skill Operation
description: Schema for a single API operation (create, list, update, delete, etc.).

endpoint.description: API endpoint path, must start with /.

action.description: OpenAPI operationId or equivalent action identifier.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this operation does.

idempotent.description: Whether repeating this operation produces the same result.

required_fields.description: Field names that must be provided for this operation.

optional_fields.description: Field names that may optionally be provided.

response_key_fields.description: Key fields returned in the response (optional, for create/mutate ops).

requires.description: Fact URIs that must be available before this operation can run.

outputs.description: Map of fact URI -> response field name for facts produced by this operation.

depends_on.description: Operations that must run before this one to satisfy field dependencies.

producer_type.description: Classification of how this operation produces facts: 'creatable' for create/update ops, 'observable' for read/list ops that expose facts, 'none' for delete/options/head.

check_with.description: Idempotency check: which list operation + match field to use for pre-flight dedup.

operation.description: Operation name to use for checking (e.g. 'list').

match_field.description: Field name to match on for dedup.

dependency.description: A dependency on another operation via a field reference.

field.description: Field name in this operation that references the dependency.

source.description: How this dependency was determined. Format: adapter_name or adapter_name:detail.

lineage_type.description: How the field value relates to the target fact.

discriminator_value.description: For polymorphic fields, the discriminator value that selects this target.
